meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (synthetic glyph writers and synthetic tremor; not a measurement); plant: pencil model P1 (sim/pencil), unmodified; synthetic writer, 100 Hz export
meta.case_group: AI guidance: a written sentence (pencil model P1)
meta.plant: model P1 (sim/pencil, unmodified): skid-paper LuGre contact, spring-loaded refill (F_c 0.15 N), four-plate piezo stage with lever, driver and hysteresis; the user force 1.0 N is split between skid and nib by the model
meta.config: pencil model P1 (sim/pencil: skid, spring-loaded refill F_c 0.15 N, piezo stage; q_lim 0.30 mm, stop 0.40 mm, user force 1.0 N)
notes: template: the template trajectory at 50 Hz including pen-up moves; template_pen_down flags its pen-down points; empty for no-guidance cases
confidence: predictor confidence of the letter being written (1 for oracle and forced cases)
authority: effective stage authority g_eff recorded by the simulator
housing: the housing datum p_H (in P1 the nominal ball centre fixed to the barrel), z = its height (mm); ink = page projection of the ball centre
metrics: path distances are to the intended path plus the static ink offset (median(ink - housing datum) in contact with the skid on the paper, same writing without tremor, neutral mode)

skid_contact: 1 while the skid is on the paper; ink in contact while it is 0 is a touchdown or lift tail (the unloaded refill protrudes up to 1.34 mm beyond its working point, about 0.87 mm on the page along the pen azimuth)
metrics_writing_only: the same metrics with the tails excluded

cases.label: AI template, prediction correct (style mismatch only)
Wrong prediction: most likely wrong letter, full authority
Wrong next word predicted for word 2
Wrong letter: 'a' template while the user writes 'o' (full authority on the o's)
